cases.purpose: Stencil clear 0/1 with no draw; empty/full Equal(1) and independent complement.
Nonempty vertical line; exact repeat; shuffled UInt16 index offset 2 equivalence; Keep empty and inequality from positive.

comparisons.diagnostic_only: All five endpoint reversal pairs. No expected covered pixel, line count, tie/endpoint rule, geometric prediction, or universal claim.
comparisons.gating: Completed GPU readbacks and all guards/padding; binary complementary Equal(1)/Equal(0) masks; nonzero color sentinels before and after; calibration empty/full; nonempty positive; exact repeat/indexed equality; Keep empty/inequality; both layout masks equal for each case; all 32 observations and exact raw byte count.

geometry_provenance: Independently created neutral integer grid coordinates /256 around 200 pixels, all drawn segments longer than 32 pixels. Fixed inputs only; no captures, external geometry, product kernel, or old case generator.
interior_margin: Exact rational minor-ordinate gap to an integer evaluated at major k+1/2, at least 8 major-axis pixels from either endpoint; reports closest nonzero gap and exact-tie count. Merely a diamond-tip geometric landmark, NOT a Metal rule or pixel-coverage prediction.
native_pipeline: Template API shim and generic MSL unchanged. Nil test fragment; Always stencil compare; Replace pass except explicit Keep control; front/back refs=1; full completion handler and status/error checks before shared-memory access.
position_mode: All cases use direct clip identity, z=0.5,w=1. Window grid /256 maps exactly to clip multiples of 1/32768. Exact storage and consumed clip bits plus CPU f64 viewport references are recorded; no native vertex readback is claimed.
public_file_policy: Only the exact hashed source allowlist; no README or markdown, workflow, private paths/data, secrets, binaries, logs, or local receipts.
qualification_scope: Only actual samples on the recorded target device/build. Host tests and fixtures never qualify native coverage. Unsupported/no-GPU, wrong device, incomplete and failing runs are UNQUALIFIED. line_coverage_rule=UNKNOWN and implementation_qualified=false even after a qualified native measurement.
